```{r}

ggplot(chi.data |> filter (trial_type == 'all_full' | trial_type == 'all_subset'), aes(x=age,y=prop,fill=trial_type)) +
  geom_point(width=0.3,color='black',shape=23, size=3) + 
  ggtitle("Proportion 'Good' Responses per Participant, Control Trials") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("blue","red")) +
  facet_grid(condition~trial_type)

ggplot(chi.data |> (trial_type == 'some_full' | trial_type == 'some_subset'), aes(x=age,y=prop,fill=trial_type)) +
  geom_point(width=0.3,color='black',shape=23, size=3) + 
  ggtitle("Proportion 'Good' Responses per Participant, Critical Trials") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("gold","green")) +
  facet_grid(condition~trial_type)



```

```{r}



summary_2 <- function (df,var) {
  df |>  group_by(var, speaker) |>
     count(var,speaker) |>
     mutate( prop = n/sum(n))
}

conversation_data |> summary_2(day_of_week)
```

## Set Up


```{r}
Study1 <- read.csv("Study1_data-1.csv")
Study2 <- read.csv("Study2_data-1.csv")
Study3 <- read.csv("Study3_data.csv")
library(tidyverse)
```


## Figure 2 and Figure 3

### Figure 2 
This figure shows the percentage of each response to the question asking participants whether they believe in moral progress across the 3 studies.

```{r}
bind_rows(
Study1 |> mutate(study="Study1"),
Study2 |> mutate(study="Study2"),
Study3 |> mutate(study="Study3")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y=study, fill = progress.belief)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill") +
  labs(x = "Percentage", y =  NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = c("0","25","50","75","100"))
```


### Figure 3

```{r}
bind_rows(
```
